newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine near cash maize slips in good trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine near cash maize slips in good trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed down in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange following a fall in nearby Chicago, traders said.

FAS elevator maize lost $1 in Buenos Aires to $104. Cash soybeans also fell, in moderate volume, influenced by lower Chicago prices. Rosario FAS elevator soybeans lost $5 to $273. FAS elevator sunflower seed lost $2 to $218 in Rosario in good trade. Continuing rain is delyaing sowing of long-cycle wheat.
